overall_goal: Add spices and salt to the mixture and saute uniformly

goals.description: Add coriander powder and salt to the pan
goals.rationale: The person scoops coriander powder and salt from their respective jars and adds them to the frying pan.

goals.description: Add red chilli powder, spices, and turmeric powder to the pan
goals.rationale: The person opens several spice jars, including red chilli and turmeric, and adds their contents to the frying pan.

goals.description: Mix and saute the contents in the pan
goals.rationale: The person uses a spatula to stir and mix the spices into the mixture in the frying pan.
